verdict.rationale: An official SDK is a fair question for an AI app-building platform, but the evidence pack never documents one for Figma Make. Syncing npm packages and design systems into Make is an input feature, not an SDK to build against. A community report says Figma's API rejects .make files, and probes for OpenAPI specs returned 404s, so there is no evidence of an official SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
